rows.t: Iran Escalation Against U.S. Naval Escorts and Risk of Major Surface Combatant Strike
rows.mechnote: Conjunctive falsifier; conflicting record and no adjudicated event
rows.falsifier: MISSES if no successful strike, sinking or major-surface-combatant hit on a US naval asset in the Gulf of Oman or Persian Gulf occurs before 2027-06-30.
rows.note:
RULE-BASED EXPIRY. Window closed 2026-11-01; resolved 2026-11-02 by Rule 1. Window closed 2026-11-01 unresolved. The card's own TIER-1 note records the 60-day falsifier window closing with no independently verified hit on a US major surface combatant, while flagging a conflicting record (IRNA claim of damage 9-16; NewsCord roundup 10-26; CENTCOM reporting interceptions, no US casualties). Under Rule 1 the absence of an adjudicated in-window event at close is a MISS, not a pending state.
DEFECT RECORDED: the falsifier is conjunctive - it requires BOTH no strike AND interceptor magazines replenished to pre-war confidence. Magazines are not replenished, so the falsifier as written never fires and the card could never be falsified. That is the card's drafting fault, not a reason to park it. Adjudicate on the substance limb only.

rows.t: SPR Runway Breaks Before Midterms — Oil Shock as Regime Fatality
rows.mechnote: Legs A and B fired end to end; leg C never fielded
rows.falsifier: MISSES if SPR crude stocks remain above 350 million barrels through 2027-03-31.
rows.note: MISS by Rule 1, and the shape of the failure matters more than the score. Legs A and B fired: the price and physical-shock chain ran end to end (Hormuz 2 vessels/day vs 85 baseline, Brent >$100 through the autumn, retail gas $4.12 on election eve, SPR below the 290M cavern floor on 9-18). But the card's own price leg DEFLATED into the vote — Brent -7.6% on election eve, largest one-day fall since July, on Hormuz reopening talk — and leg C, the fatality threshold (>=25% of switcher reasons energy/fuel), was never fielded by the exit instrument, so it cannot be adjudicated. A compound card with one unmeasurable leg cannot be confirmed by its true legs. Scored MISS, with the causal chain recorded as a confirmed mechanism the register failed to capture as a scorable claim.

rows.t: House passes the Massie privileged resolution on Hegseth on or before 2026-11-12
rows.mechnote: Right about failure, wrong by one step: priced tabling, got referral
rows.falsifier: Two or more named Republican members stating publicly before the vote that they will vote no, or a motion to table reported as likely by leadership-aligned outlets, moves the estimate down at least 15 points. A White House statement that the President will not oppose the vote moves it up 10.
rows.note: MISS, in-window, at 21:0x ET on 2026-11-10 — one day before expiry and before any outcome was visible when the score was cut from 38 to 23. The House disposed of the resolution by adopting a motion to refer it to committee, 211-204 (Massie the only Republican voting no; more Democrats absent than Republicans, which supplied the margin). No vote was taken on the eight articles themselves, so the instrument recorded nothing about Hegseth: the resolution failed a recorded vote without the chamber ever voting on the substance. Score at resolution: 23. Base rate 18. The card was right about the direction (favoured failure) and wrong about the mechanism by one step — it priced tabling as the likely kill and got referral.
